customManagers.description: biome.jsonc pins its $schema to a Biome version, so it has to move with the dependency instead of waiting to be noticed.

packageRules.description: engines.node is the support floor this package promises to its consumers. Raising it is a breaking change to publish deliberately, not a dependency to track.
Every dependency here is a devDependency, and lint, typecheck, tests and pack all run on Node 22, 24 and 26, so patch and minor updates can ride on a green run.

The libraries the benchmark measures against. Their versions are recorded in benchmark/results.json, and the figures docs/*/benchmark.md publish were measured with them, so these land as one reviewed change rather than drifting one package at a time.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Merging this invalidates the published benchmark. Run `pnpm benchmark`, then update `docs/en/benchmark.md`, `docs/ja/benchmark.md` and `benchmark/results.json` in the same change.
